blind.description: A straight section of a classic dressed stone parapet or low boundary wall. It features a rounded top coping rail, recessed rectangular decorative panels with moulded borders on the front and back faces, and a flared moulded base that sits flat against the ground. The material is weathered cream/beige stone with realistic green moss or lichen staining and darker grey weathered ends on the coping.
blind.from_above: A simple rectangular stone coping strip with rounded edges and darker grey capped ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (just under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 to 6 feet long.

notes: Height is slightly lower than catalog specification (2.0 ft vs 3.0 ft) but reads cleanly as a low wall section
